posts.content_md:
HoloWorld Update 9-13-05

Greetings HoloWorld Subscribers

-- New HoloTalk

In this installment of HoloTalk, my guest is Sven-Goran Pettersson of the holography lab at Lund University. Our topic of discussion is full-color holography, and the programs offered at Lund. Also included on the HoloTalk page is a document download titled: "A holographic system for fast exposure of true color holograms" -- which explains the process used in detail, along with photos of their lab and color holograms.

This new show and document is available now at:

[http://www.holoworld.com/holotalk](http://www.holoworld.com/holotalk)

Regards,

Frank DeFreitas

[http://www.holoworld.com](http://www.holoworld.com)

The latest holotalk is available now

"I welcome guest Patrick Boyd in this new installment of HoloTalk. Patrick speaks about the new London School of Holography programs, and also talks about his own history within holography spanning 20 years. Patrick Boyd has an MA in holography from the Royal College of Art and has won many awards including a Fulbright Fellowship and exhibited in many countries world wide."

[http://www.holoworld.com/holotalk/](http://www.holoworld.com/holotalk/)

Frank doesn't seem to include the MP3's in his online archive so if you want your own copies, download each before the next show comes on.
